name: Earthmover
description: (Tag:mechanical)(Tag:ranger)(Tag:tech)(Tag:titanic-size)(Tech)THR 1000 - Earthmover is a titanic Supreme Machine and moving military base that razes cities, with a Lightning Spear eclipsing most nuclear weapons and a forcefield that withstands its own spears. It also carries missile platforms, giant autocannons, laser cannons, a livable small city on its back, and repair drones. It requires sunlight and blood to function, with ammunition and blood reserves refueled every 24 hours.
